answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the walnut is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The inlet holds work receipts rather than names, so the juniper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
